prompt: I'm 29 years old, non-smoker, employed, single, no kids, no mortgage. I pay about S$5,747 a year in premiums across these policies: MediShield Life (auto), a 1997 GE WholeLife Premier (S$1,800/yr, cash value S$18k), a 2001 GE GreatLink Supreme (S$1,440/yr, cash value S$42k), and a 2014 GE GreatLink FlexiPlan (S$2,077/yr, account value S$31k). Income S$60k/yr. CPF: OA S$45k, SA S$28k, MA S$8k. Cash S$12k. Is my plan good or not? Should I surrender any of the legacy plans?
expected_output: Categorized portfolio, FAA-N16 surrender warning with sunk-cost math, LIA gap analysis (Income x 10 Death, Income x 4 CI), M9A ILP flag on FlexiPlan, Premium Overhead Inefficiency diagnosis, FAA-N20 BSC, CPF optimisation, National Protection integration (MediShield + CareShield + HPS), prioritised action checklist (Sequence-style, risk-first), sources block, SG-FA disclaimer

assertions.name: portfolio_categorised_into_buckets
assertions.description: Output must categorise policies into Hospitalisation / Death-TPD / CI / PA / Investment-Legacy buckets

assertions.name: fAA_N16_surrender_warning_verbatim
assertions.description: Output must include the FAA-N16 / RES5 surrender warning verbatim with the required language
assertions.check: output contains 'Surrender warning' AND 'FAA-N16' AND 'you may receive less than the total premiums paid'

assertions.name: sunk_cost_table_present
assertions.description: Output must show a sunk-cost vs cash-value table for legacy policies
assertions.check: output contains 'sunk-cost' AND 'cash value' AND 'Unrecoverable cost'

assertions.name: LIA_gap_formulas_used
assertions.description: Output must apply the LIA standard gap formulas (Income x 10 Death, Income x 4 CI)
assertions.check: output contains 'Income' AND 'x 10' AND 'x 4' AND ('Death' or 'TPD') AND 'CI'

assertions.name: gap_table_with_target_and_aggregated
assertions.description: Output must show a gap table with target and aggregated sum assured columns

assertions.name: M9A_ILP_flag_on_FlexiPlan
assertions.description: Output must flag the FlexiPlan as an ILP conflict using M9A keywords (Link / Flexi / Sub-Funds)
assertions.check: output contains 'M9A' AND ('Link' or 'Flexi' or 'Sub-Funds' or 'Premium Allocation') AND 'ILP'

assertions.name: premium_overhead_inefficiency_diagnosis
assertions.description: Output must diagnose the Premium Overhead Inefficiency
assertions.check: output contains 'Premium Overhead' AND ('Inefficiency' or 'drag' or 'overpaying' or 'overhead')

assertions.name: FAA_N20_balanced_scorecard_present
assertions.description: Output must include the FAA-N20 Balanced Scorecard (BSC) with 4 quadrants
assertions.check: output contains 'FAA-N20' AND 'Balanced Scorecard' AND 'Q1' AND 'Q2' AND 'Q3' AND 'Q4'

assertions.name: national_protection_stack_checked
assertions.description: Output must verify the National Protection stack: MediShield Life, CareShield Life, HPS
assertions.check: output contains 'MediShield Life' AND 'CareShield Life' AND 'HPS'

assertions.name: CPF_optimisation_present
assertions.description: Output must include CPF optimisation: OA vs SA, cashflow, emergency fund
assertions.check: output contains 'CPF' AND 'SA' AND 'OA' AND 'Emergency Fund'

assertions.name: sequence_style_action_checklist
assertions.description: Output must include a prioritised Sequence-style action checklist (risk-first)
assertions.check: output contains 'Action Checklist' AND ('Sequence' or 'prioritised' or 'prioritized') AND 'Risk' AND 'Cashflow'

assertions.name: no_buy_imperative
assertions.description: Output must NOT include 'you should buy' or 'I recommend you buy' imperative language
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'you should buy' or 'I recommend you buy' or 'I recommend buying'

assertions.name: no_price_targets
assertions.description: Output must NOT include specific price targets or guaranteed returns
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'price target' or 'target price' or 'PT $' or 'guaranteed return' or 'guaranteed 5%'

assertions.name: no_urgent_cancellation_of_national_layers
assertions.description: Output must NOT recommend cancelling MediShield Life or CareShield Life
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'cancel MediShield' or 'opt out of CareShield' or 'cancel your CareShield'

assertions.name: sources_grouped
assertions.description: Output must have a Sources block grouped by category
assertions.check: output contains '## Sources' AND output contains at least 2 of: '**MAS', '**LIA', '**CPF', '**Insurer'

assertions.name: sg_fa_disclaimer_verbatim
assertions.description: Output must end with the verbatim SG-FA disclaimer (surrender-irreversible language required)
assertions.check: output contains 'Surrendering a life policy is an irreversible decision' AND 'LIA Consumer Guide' AND 'not personalised financial advice'
